description: This PHP source file provides utility functions for exporting data from SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM modules to CSV format. It includes functions for generating CSV content, handling related data, managing export order, and providing sample data, all tailored for exporting CRM records with support for custom fields, localization, and permissions.

classes.name: CleanCSV
classes.description: A class used for escaping and cleaning CSV fields to ensure proper formatting and escaping of special characters.

methods.name: getDelimiter
methods.description: Returns the system default delimiter or an override based on user preference and configuration settings.

methods.name: printCSV
methods.description: Outputs CSV data with appropriate headers for file download, handling encoding based on configuration.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Builds CSV data for exporting CRM module records, including handling localization, related records, custom fields, and exporting options like sample data.

methods.name: exportSample
methods.description: Generates a sample CSV file with instructional text to demonstrate exporting.

methods.name: returnFakeDataRow
methods.description: Creates sample data rows with dummy data for testing export formatting.

methods.name: parseRelateFields
methods.description: Replaces relate field placeholders with actual related data in the CSV output.

methods.name: generateSearchWhere
methods.description: Constructs a WHERE clause for search filtering when exporting, based on saved search forms and parameters.

methods.name: translateForExport
methods.description: Translates database field names to user-friendly labels, considering module-specific language strings and overrides.

methods.name: get_field_order_mapping
methods.description: Defines or reorders the column display order for export, with module-specific default arrangements.
